title: Last 12 Months tile window opens Technician Efficiency on the Last 12 months preset
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin (storage state)
A billable technician exists (minted via API)
An invoiced Work Order for a test-created customer carries that technician's closed clock hours on its labour line, dated ~3 months before the workplace's today (outside This Month, inside Last 12 Months)

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /dashboard and wait for the tiles
Set the Technician Efficiency tile's date pill to "Last 12 Months"
Inspect the Technician Efficiency tile's report link

custom_steps_separated.expected:
The pill reads "Last 12 Months" and the headline re-renders
The link points at /reports/technician-efficiency with range=last_12_months (a single preset value, no custom triple)
The new tab's URL carries range=last_12_months
The report's date chip reads "Last 12 months" and the seeded technician's row is listed
